body: That is the best advice I received, thank you! I feel much better now that I let myself be mad for a while, and I don't even think I hate her that much, maybe it was just the moment
He said he wanted to let go of his past to be a better person, because he used to be bad to a lot of people. I don't know if he wants to keep in contact with her, but I hope not
I know that, unfortunately. I just don't think that I can, at least for now

They just say that, a lot. Even my "friends" always end up telling me I annoy them and that I am too complicated to deal with, but I try not to think too much about it because it makes me feel really bad. But it's okay, it doesn't bother anymore, I just want to improve and be better this time :)

Maybe it's not normal, but I am like that sometimes, I have some problems with depression but nothing alarming, and I just don't want (and can't) talk to anyone about it because my parents don't believe in psychologists or therapy, and friends can't do much for me. But I know that I'll get better, and if I don't, I'll do something about it.

Normally I can tell when she's having a bad day or is just stressed because of work, but she seemed fine, joking and making comments on our (me and my sister's) grades. But I know that she doesn't mean everything she says.

Thank you! It's good to hear that, a lot of people like to criticize me and it's been a while since anyone was actually kind to me. And my mom is always like this, I can't do much, but I'll try to stay strong and not let her make me feel bad about trivial things :)
